Notes:
[1] Amended due dates and new program elements will be indicated with bold red text as ROSES-2025 is amended through the year.
[2] See Sections IV(b)(vi) and IV(b)(vii) of the Summary of Solicitation for a discussion of Notice of Intent (NOI) vs. a Step-1 proposal. If NOIs are requested, a due date is provided in the table. If NOIs are required by a program in order to be able to submit a proposal, it will be indicated on this table with "(Mandatory)". If NOIs are replaced by a Step-1 proposal, the table entry will include that information.
[3] Proposals for Rapid Response and Novel Research in Earth Science may be submitted at any time up to December 31, 2026, when it is anticipated that ROSES-2026 will be open. Proposers should carefully read the solicitation for information about review schedule and possible restrictions on, for example, proposal resubmissions.
[4] Proposals for A.10 INNOVATE may be submitted at any time up to August 31, 2026. Proposers should carefully read the solicitation for information about review schedule and possible restrictions on, for example, proposal resubmissions.
[5] Proposals for C.2 Solar System Science may be submitted at any time up to November 12, 2026, when it is anticipated that ROSES-2026 will be open. Proposers should carefully read the solicitation for information about review schedule and possible restrictions on, for example, proposal resubmissions
